answer_text: Connected: This event is generated after a tunnel has been connected to the PoP for 30 seconds, provided the link is Active. Disconnected: This event is generated when a tunnel disconnects. However, if the disconnection lasts less than 2.5 minutes, a single Reconnected event is emitted instead of the Disconnected (and later Connected) events. If the disconnection lasts longer than 2.5 minutes, you will see the standard Disconnected event (and a subsequent Connected event when the tunnel re-establishes.
